title: GAO-22-104746 — Federal Response to SolarWinds and Microsoft Exchange Incidents
description: Case Study 005 · U.S. Government Accountability Office. Reviews the federal response to two incidents. Use the SolarWinds-specific findings when tracing this case.

title: CISA Emergency Directive 21-01 — Mitigate SolarWinds Orion Code Compromise
description: Case Study 005 · CISA’s directive set required federal mitigations. Direct access could not be verified in this audit. The GAO report in this collection corroborates issuance and summarizes the directive.

title: Department of Justice Statement on SolarWinds Update
description: Case Study 005 · DOJ reported that about 3% of its Microsoft 365 mailboxes may have been accessed. This figure describes potential access. The statement gives no confirmed extraction count.

title: CMS — Health Care Claim or Equivalent Encounter Information
description: Case Study 006 · CMS explains electronic claim submission standards, including X12 837 for medical claims and NCPDP D.0 for retail pharmacy claims. Payment system reference.

title: CMS — Electronic Funds Transfer
description: Case Study 006 · CMS explains how Medicare sends electronic claim payments to a provider’s financial institution. Payment system reference for the settlement stage.

title: CMS — Continued Action on the Change Healthcare Cyberattack
description: Case Study 006 · CMS announced Medicare payment support and directed contractors to expedite alternative clearinghouse arrangements and accept paper claims where needed.

title: CMS — Change Healthcare/Optum Payment Disruption Program FAQs
description: Case Study 006 · Medicare eligibility, calculation, and recovery rules for emergency accelerated and advance payments. See questions 2 and 12–15 for repayment timing and offsets.

title: CMS — Change Healthcare Cybersecurity Incident and State Medicaid Flexibilities
description: Case Study 006 · Federal guidance setting out limited Medicaid enforcement flexibility. The bulletin does not establish which options an individual state adopted.

title: U.S. Senate Finance Committee — Andrew Witty’s Change Healthcare Testimony
description: Case Study 006 · Company testimony to Congress. Pages 4–5 distinguish pharmacy recovery, medical claims volume, payment-processing recovery, and provider funding.

title: CMS — Closing the Medicare Change Healthcare Payment Disruption Program
description: Case Study 006 · CMS reported Part A and Part B advance amounts and the share recovered by June 17. New applications ended after July 12, 2024.

title: UnitedHealth Group — 2024 Form 10-K, Change Healthcare Financial Impact
description: Case Study 006 · Company disclosures on interest-free provider loans, direct response costs, and business-disruption impacts. These are distinct financial measures.

title: SEC filing — Provider repayment of Change Healthcare funding, Note 4
description: Case Study 006 · One reporting company documents temporary assistance, a repayment notice following restored connectivity, and a balance still outstanding in September 2025. Use as a single-provider example.

title: Testimony of Andrew Witty
description: Case Study 006 · House testimony on the reported initial access, ransomware timeline and ransom decision.

title: Hacking America's Health Care: Assessing the Change Healthcare Cyberattack and What's Next
description: Case Study 006 · Official hearing record, including testimony on notification, response and oversight.

title: Responses to Questions for the Record for Andrew Witty
description: Case Study 006 · Written responses on pre-incident multifactor authentication policy and post-discovery response.

title: Senator Cassidy letter to Andrew Witty
description: Case Study 006 · Senate oversight letter requesting acquisition, integration and cybersecurity records.

title: Senator Wyden letter to the FTC and SEC
description: Case Study 006 · Senate letter requesting FTC and SEC investigation. The letter is a request for inquiry.

title: Senator Wyden follow-up letter to UnitedHealth Group
description: Case Study 006 · Senate follow-up requesting audit documentation and additional answers.

title: United States v. UnitedHealth Group and Change Healthcare, Memorandum Opinion
description: Case Study 006 · Federal district court memorandum opinion in the pre-incident merger litigation.
